mdSummary:
# IconPicker

Popover with a searchable, virtualized icon grid — pack-agnostic, works with any Lumeo.Icons.* pack.

**Package:** `Lumeo` · **Category:** Forms
**Docs:** https://lumeo.nativ.sh/components/icon-picker

## Parameters
| Owner | Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IconPicker | FormField | `FormField.FormFieldContext?` | `` |  |
| IconPicker | Value | `string?` | `` | The selected icon's Name, or null when nothing is selected. |
| IconPicker | ValueChanged | `EventCallback<string?>` | `` | Raised when the selection changes — via a grid click, Enter, or Clearable's clear affordance (with null). |
| IconPicker | Icons | `IReadOnlyList<IconPickerItem>` | `Array.Empty<IconPickerItem>()` | The candidate icons. Pack-agnostic on purpose: the core package references no individual icon pack assembly, so a consumer builds this list from whichever Lumeo.Icons.* pack(s) they installed (see the docs page for a reflection helper over a pack's static class, the same technique the docs site's own icon gallery uses). |
| IconPicker | Placeholder | `string?` | `` | Placeholder shown on the trigger when nothing is selected. |
| IconPicker | Searchable | `bool` | `true` | When true (default), a search box narrows Icons by name and Keywords, case-insensitively. |
| IconPicker | Columns | `int` | `8` | Number of icons per grid row. Default 8. |
| IconPicker | Size | `Lumeo.Size` | `Lumeo.Size.Md` | Size for the trigger's height/padding. Default Md. |
| IconPicker | Disabled | `bool` | `false` | Disables the trigger, preventing the popover from opening. |
| IconPicker | Clearable | `bool` | `false` | When true, an inline clear (×) affordance appears on the trigger whenever an icon is selected. |
| IconPicker | ShowLabel | `bool` | `false` | When true, the selected icon's Name renders next to its glyph on the trigger. Default false (glyph only). |
| IconPicker | FullWidth | `bool` | `false` | Stretches the trigger (and popover) to the width of its container. |
| IconPicker | Open | `bool` | `false` | Popover open state. Bind via @bind-Open for a controlled picker (recommended inside a heavily re-rendering parent — same guidance as Combobox.Open). |
| IconPicker | OpenChanged | `EventCallback<bool>` | `` | Raised whenever the popover opens or closes. |
| IconPicker | Required | `bool` | `false` | Marks the field as required, rendering a destructive-colored asterisk next to Label (standalone usage only). |
| IconPicker | Invalid | `bool` | `false` | Forces the invalid/error visual state, independent of an ambient FormField's validation state. |
| IconPicker | ErrorText | `string?` | `` | Error message shown below the trigger (standalone usage only) when Invalid is set. |
| IconPicker | HelperText | `string?` | `` | Helper text shown below the trigger (standalone usage only) when there is no error to display. |
| IconPicker | Label | `string?` | `` | Label rendered above the trigger (standalone usage only — inside a FormField, the FormField owns the label). |
| IconPicker | Name | `string?` | `` | HTML name attribute applied to the trigger, for native form association. |
| IconPicker | Class | `string?` | `` | Additional CSS classes merged onto the trigger button. |
| IconPicker | AdditionalAttributes | `Dictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Unmatched attributes splatted onto the trigger button. |

## Slots
- (none)

## Events
- `ValueChanged` (`EventCallback<string?>`) — Raised when the selection changes — via a grid click, Enter, or Clearable's clear affordance (with null).
- `OpenChanged` (`EventCallback<bool>`) — Raised whenever the popover opens or closes.

## Sub-components
- (none)

## Cascading values it expects
- `FormField` (`FormField.FormFieldContext?`)

## Services it injects
- `IComponentInteropService` ()
- `ILumeoLocalizer` (Lumeo.Services.Localization)

## Keyboard
- `ArrowRight` — HandleGridKeyDown handles ArrowRight in IconPicker.razor
- `ArrowLeft` — HandleGridKeyDown handles ArrowLeft in IconPicker.razor
- `ArrowDown` — HandleGridKeyDown handles ArrowDown in IconPicker.razor
- `ArrowUp` — HandleGridKeyDown handles ArrowUp in IconPicker.razor
- `Home` — HandleGridKeyDown handles Home in IconPicker.razor
- `End` — HandleGridKeyDown handles End in IconPicker.razor
- `Enter` — HandleGridKeyDown handles Enter in IconPicker.razor

## Example
```razor
<IconPicker />
```
